hush.line: Every chord starts with one voice.

chord.heading: Five voices, one chord
chord.hint: Scroll, or tap a voice to light it.

chord.voicesLabel: The five voices, in stage order
chord.resolve: Five voices and nothing else. This is our Carol of the Bells, the song of our most watched video ({views} views).

proof.heading: Found on a phone, booked for the stage
proof.body: The five have {followers} followers across networks and {views} views behind them. Carol of the Bells alone has {carol}.

rooms.heading: Music for conferences and corporate events in Zagreb
rooms.body: We open conferences, sing at award galas and come back with short sets between sessions. There is no stage to build: five singers at microphones, from a moment of up to {shortest} minutes to a full concert. For the longest show we bring our own piano and cajón.
rooms.weddings: The ceremony, a surprise for the couple, or the whole evening.
rooms.advent: Advent stages and summer concerts for cities and tourist boards.
rooms.private: A short surprise for your guests, or a whole concert.

encore.heading: Bring five voices to your event.
encore.body: Tell us the date and the city.
